name: Algebraic Surface Raycasting
aliases: Implicit Surface Raycasting via Polynomial Composition
definition: A rendering approach where the core steps are composition (transforming a trivariate polynomial to a univariate polynomial along a ray) and rootfinding (finding the first root of the polynomial minus the isovalue).
summary: Algebraic Surface Raycasting renders implicit surfaces by transforming 3D fields into 1D univariate polynomials along rays, distinguishing itself from voxel-based methods through exact global polynomial composition rather than local cell traversal.
